description: Shared types for Rainshare: friends' sidequests, taken on with spare agent usage.

setup.description: One agent setup: the harness that runs it and the models it uses.

models.description: Model identifiers, as the harness names them (for example claude-opus-5-5).

plan.description: The plan or account behind it, in your words (for example "Claude Max 20x" or "API, pay as I go").

forecast.description: How much spare usage you have right now, and until when.

level.description: dry: nothing to spare. drizzle: a small task or two. showers: a few sessions. downpour: lots, and it resets soon.

until.description: When this forecast runs out, often when your plan's usage resets.
